dominant_strengths: Confident type pairing — italic serif date over bold serif 'Today' creates a calm, editorial header anchor.
Restrained pastel tag system with matched dot indicators reads as a coherent, well-tuned color language.
Generous whitespace and clear Today/Upcoming sectioning give the list strong scannable rhythm.
dominant_weaknesses: Highly conventional Things/Todoist archetype — nothing structurally new, distinctiveness and innovation are low.
The 14% progress ring feels visually disconnected: blue stroke clashes slightly with warm cream canvas and serif header.
Repeating 'Today' label on every item below a 'TODAY' section header is redundant noise that weakens information hierarchy.
fix_priorities: Remove redundant 'Today' meta on items already grouped under TODAY; show only date when it differs.
Rework progress indicator — match stroke to ink tone or integrate into header typography for cohesion.
Introduce one distinctive interaction or layout idea (timeline, weight, energy) to escape the generic todo template.
rationale.norman_balance: Solid behavioral clarity and pleasant visceral calm, but reflective payoff is limited because the design says nothing memorable about the user's relationship to their day.
rationale.intent_fit: Yes — it competently delivers a task-list with grouping, tags, completion state, and shortcut affordance, just without a strong point of view.
